title: Search and Rescue - Rebel Heart
description: California Air National Guard HH-60G Pave Hawk rescue helicopter assigned with the 129th Rescue Squadron, Moffett Federal Airfield, Calif., receives aerial refuel from an MC-130P Combat Shadow aircraft during an over water rescue operation of a seriously ill one-year old infant onboard a 36-foot sailing vessel, Rebel Heart, 900 nautical miles of the coast of Mexico, April 4, 2014.  (U.S. Air National Guard video by Airman 1st Class Julia Bates/Released)
keywords: ANG, California Air National Guard, United States Air Force, USAF, 129th Rescue Wing, Aerial Refuel, MC-130P combat shadow, Rebel Heart, search and rescue, HH-60G Pave Hawk
pass_reason: Seriously ill infant case; medical, and mostly refueling footage.
